name: @atomic-integrations/timesheets-app
description: Clockify timesheets drive app. Records the version its catalog entry and apps/timesheets/<version>/ui.js carry (integrations/tooling/apps.mjs). Its one npm dependency, devonian, is for the Clockify lens prototype's tests in ../devonian/clockify/; the app's bundle does not import it. Not a certified sandbox package (no atomicCertification).
